observation.command: TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token.txt); echo "=== CORS preflight from 4200 ==="; curl -s -i -X OPTIONS http://localhost:5000/api/strasse -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: authorization" | head -15; echo "=== other endpoints ==="; for p in strasse namenskomplex ortsteil stadtbezirk vorgang beschluss; do printf "%-16s " "$p"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:5000/api/$p; done
